description: STR_1631 base + Regime-Conditional Weight Switching: NORMAL=EW, CAUTION=HRP, CRISIS=MinVar(OAS). S0 record and plan at stage_artifacts/.
instructions: 1. Copy STR_1631 structure to STR_1639 directory
2. factor_engine.R: identical to STR_1631 (C19 + MAX exclusion + N=20)
3. regime_allocator.R: identical to STR_1631 (3-layer asset allocation)
4. NEW: regime_weight_switcher.R — implements regime-conditional weight switching
- CAUTION (30 <= MRS < 60): HRP with OAS expanding covariance
- CRISIS (MRS >= 60 confirmed): MinVar with OAS expanding covariance
5. run_all.R: Phase 4 uses regime_weight_switcher instead of fixed weight_method='equal'
6. PIT CRITICAL: covariance estimation = expanding window (start ~ t-1 ONLY). No rebalancing-day returns.
7. Weight bounds: lb=0.02, ub=0.15 for HRP and MinVar
8. OAS shrinkage: use corpcor::cov.shrink() or manual OAS implementation
9. HRP implementation: hierarchical clustering (hclust) + recursive bisection (from STR_1028 code)
10. MinVar: quadprog::solve.QP or manual closed-form with constraints (from STR_1035 code)
11. Run backtest, generate charts, hurdle gate
